programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion-dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: South Park: With Apologies to Jesse Jackson
programme.desc: With Apologies to Jessie Jackson: Randy faces public ridicule for using the "N" word on live TV. Cartman can't resist teasing a little person who comes to school to teach about prejudice. (S11, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Hotter Than Summer: Cartman Sucks
programme.desc: Cartman Sucks: After being caught in a compromising position with Eric, Butters is sent to a special camp to "Pray the Gay Away". Cartman tries to retrieve the incriminating photo. (S11, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Lice Capades
programme.desc: Lice Capades: Eric tries to discover the source of an outbreak of lice at the school. The lice are living peacefully in a village until they see the school nurse staring at them! (S11, E03)

programme.title: South Park: The Snuke
programme.desc: The Snuke: The citizens of South Park are gearing up for the arrival of Hillary Clinton. Eric suspects that a new student is planning a terrorist attack but the real culprits are deadlier. (S11, E04)

programme.title: South Park: Fantastic Easter Special
programme.desc: Fantastic Easter Special: Stan sets out to find a reason for painting Easter eggs and discovers his father is part of a society called "The Hare Club For Men", but all is not what it seems. (S11, E05)

programme.title: South Park: D-Yikes!
programme.desc: D-Yikes!: Ms. Garrison decides that she is a lesbian after getting dumped again but hell breaks loose when her new favourite lesbian bar faces a takeover from Persians in a '300' stylee. (S11, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Night of the Living Homeless
programme.desc: Night of the Living Homeless: When a plague of homeless people hits South Park, the boys devise a plan to move them on whilst the adults panic like they're in a zombie movie. (S11, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Le Petite Tourette: Cartman experiences bliss when he discovers that, by pretending to have Tourettes, he can say whatever he likes to whoever he likes! Naturally, national TV beckons. (S11, E08)

programme.title: South Park: More Cr*p
programme.desc: More Cr*p: Inadvertently, Randy breaks the world record for the 'biggest cr*p'! Bono, the previous holder, is determined to regain his crown - but he has a dark secret which may stop him. (S11, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland: Episode I
programme.desc: Imaginationland - Episode I: The boys find themselves in a magical land where all of the world's imagination is laid out before them. (S11, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland: Episode II
programme.desc: Imaginationland - Episode II: The government are holding Stan and Kyle captive, to find out how they got into Imaginationland. Butters is in trouble with evil creatures like Snarf! (S11, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland: Episode III
programme.desc: Imaginationland- Episode III: Stan and Butters are stuck in Imaginationland fighting for their lives, while Cartman goes all the way to the supreme court to get Kyle to pay up on their bet. (S11, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O
programme.desc: Guitar Queer-o: Stan and Kyle are set to hit big time with their skills on computer game Guitar Hero. Their manager convinces Stan that Kyle is holding him back. Will the "band" break up? (S11, E13)

programme.title: South Park: The List
programme.desc: The List: The boys steal a list from the girls which rates their looks from the cutest to the ugliest. Spirits plummet, while for others egos inflate! Can the ghost of Abraham Lincoln help? (S11, E14)

programme.desc: Andy's world explodes when a fresh-faced university student is killed in a random shooting, and a bullet hits Andy, lodging in her vest.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Might Have Been

programme.title: Sea Patrol: Episode 004
programme.desc: The Hammersley rescues a former Navy officer lost at sea, with shocking consequences for the crew. Mike and Spider are taken hostage during a shoot-out with weapons smugglers.

programme.title: Sea Patrol: Episode 005
programme.desc: A special bond is formed between an uncommunicative child in desperate circumstances and one of the Hammersley's young guns as Spider tries to free a child slave from an illegal fishing boat, landing himself in hot water.

programme.title: Sea Patrol: Episode 006
programme.desc: The crew of the HMAS Hammersley are assigned the task of protecting a shipment of nuclear waste from a terrorist attack.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Bad Moon
programme.desc: As a full moon hangs over the city, the rookies are unnerved by a series of strange occurrences. While investigating the theft of three severed heads, Andy and Swarek pick up the trail of a mentally unstable man who has stopped taking his medication

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Heart & Sparks
programme.desc: As 15 Division recovers from the shooting of Det. Luke Callaghan, a series of arsons culminates in the torching of a laundromat – and the rookies are forced to confront their own burning issues.

programme.title: True Justice

programme.title: True Justice

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Elijah Kane’s SIU team tracks down a dangerous Yakuza gang as they attempt to distribute explosives to Afghanistan.

programme.title: True Justice

programme.title: The Border

programme.title: The Border

programme.desc: Dos entidades vagan por una granja de 200 años de antigüedad, aterrorizando a la familia que vive allí; pero están decididos a quedarse en la casa, aumentando la actividad paranormal a niveles amenazantes.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Dos hermanos se encuentran con una entidad demoníaca en los bosques alrededor de su casa en Florida y se enfrentan a ella décadas después.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una entidad oscura se despierta en una mansión del siglo XIX; la familia Rice experimenta una aterradora persecución y finalmente tiene que abandonar la casa de sus sueños.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: John Drenner, Jr. encuentra una biblia satánica y, sin saberlo, desata un demonio implacable que no se detendrá ante nada para destruirlo.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La casa de ensueño de una familia se convierte en su pesadilla cuando se manifiesta un fantasma abusivo. Ante la violencia del ente, buscan a una empática y descubren la oscura historia de la propiedad.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: El fuego revela el oscuro y mortal pasado del nuevo hogar de una familia. Deben encontrar ayuda antes de que el demonio también acabe con sus vidas.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Tras su mudanza a una granja en Ohio, la familia Cain descubre que su idílico hogar está embrujado por los fantasmas de un brutal asesinato y un incendio mortal.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una familia se muda a una casa con una historia oscura y oculta y pronto se percatan de que no están solos. Los rituales oscuros y la muerte han atraído al mal a la casa y los niños son su objetivo.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando un implacable demonio amenaza con la vida de la familia Cupit, un equipo de investigadores paranormales y demonólogos luchan contra la fuerza del mal para obligarla a regresar al infierno.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Una serie de eventos inexplicables dejan al descubierto una larga historia de muerte en torno a la nueva casa de los Yaple. Cuando la familia es atacada, buscan ayuda especializada antes de que el demonio que cambia de forma aumente su crueldad.

programme.title: Las Cariñosas
programme.desc: Laura, Lola y Carmen son tres mujeres muy guapas y enfermeras de un sanatorio, que provocan que los enfermos del sexo masculino se enfermen más, para que estas bellas jóvenes sigan atendiéndoles.

programme.title: Los Barbaros Del Norte
programme.desc: Olivia Fullet, va en busca de su hermano Antonio quien según esta a punto de llegar en su barco a la playa proveniente de Panama junto con su amigo Pierre. Antes de llegar, su pequeño barco se estrella en las rocas, quedando un solo sobreviviente.

programme.title: Me Gustan Todas
programme.desc: Tras recibir el consejo de su doctor de cabecera, Don Nicanor, un adinerado hombre de nacionalidad mexicana, decide ir en busca de su hija perdida Rosita, quien radica en la Habana, Cuba. Decide contratar a dos agentes para que den con su paradero.

programme.title: Mis Tres Viudas Alegres
programme.desc: México, años 50. En plena noche de bodas con su esposa Silvia, el viejo sabio José se muere. Aparecen otras viudas suyas, la cubana Amalia y la francesa Lilia. El les deja 60 millones de pesos a estas a cambio de que encuentren a un hijo.

programme.title: Piernas De Oro
programme.desc: En una carrera de bicicletas, Clavillazo vence a Esteban quien siempre había sido el campeón municipal. El coronel García ordena que formen una cuarteta con Clavillazo. Esteban y otros, para correr en la vuelta al centro de la república.

programme.title: Platillos Voladores
programme.desc: Marciano y Saturnina, van a un baile de disfraces con trajes interplanetarios. Al producirse una pelea entre el joven y un pretendiente de la muchacha a quien apoya su padre, la pareja escapa en un artefacto inventado por Marciano que es mecánico.

programme.title: Pobre Huerfanita
programme.desc: Virginia es una niña que lo tiene todo en la vida, menos el cariño de su padre que por tener tanto dinero se la viven de fiesta en fiesta, por lo que le brindan muy poco a casi nada de atención quedando siempre al cuidado de una institutriz.

programme.title: Que Hombre Tan Sin Embargo
programme.desc: Filomeno, es un hombre que llega a casa de Laura cuando mas lo necesita. El es un simple desconocido para Laura y su familia adinerada y de prestigio que por el momento pasa por una crisis financiera, ya que la industria de la sal estan en quiebra.

programme.title: Que Lindo Cha Cha Cha
programme.desc: El diablo, molesto porque Don Candido, el presidente municipal de un pueblo esta moralizando las costumbres del pueblo que gobierna, envia a uno de sus subordinados a la tierra para corromper el ambiente mediante la organizacion de un cabaret.

programme.title: Recien Casados... No Molestar
programme.desc: Catalina y Andres son una joven pareja a punto de casarse. Cada uno tiene su despedida de soltero con sus amigos y amigas respectivamente, donde intentan hacerles ver los pros y los contras del matrimonio con un poco de satira.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: James Hunt y Niki Lauda, dos pilotos de Fórmula 1 extremadamente hábiles, mantienen entre sí una intensa rivalidad. Sin embargo, es su enemistad lo que les lleva al límite.

programme.title: Juana de Arco
programme.desc: Guiada por visiones divinas, Juana de Arco, adolescente del siglo XV, lidera a Francia en guerra. Parte 2.

programme.title: Hitler: El ascenso del mal - Parte 2
programme.desc: Una perspectiva única, que perfila la vida de Adolf Hitler como un niño y su ascenso a través de las filas del Partido Nacional Alemán de los Trabajadores antes de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Negación
programme.desc: La prestigiosa escritora e historiadora Deborah E. Lipstadt debe luchar por la verdad histórica para demostrar que el Holocausto ocurrió realmente cuando David Irving, un renombrado negacionista, la demanda por difamación.

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: Mi pie izquierdo
programme.desc: Ganadora de Oscars (1989): Mejor Actor y Actriz secundaria. Basada en la biografía de Christy Brown. Aquejado de parálisis cerebral, gracias a su tenacidad y al incondicional apoyo de su madre, consiguió su integración en la sociedad.

programme.title: Tucker: El hombre y su sueño
programme.desc: Un diseñador de coches se enfrenta a toda la industria automovilística con sus revolucionarios diseños.

programme.title: Calígula
programme.desc: Detalla la historia impactante, pero innegablemente trágica, del césar más infame de Roma, Calígula.

programme.title: La verdad puede matar
programme.desc: Un conductor enfrenta a la amante musulmana de su jefe fallecido y a su primo gánster.

programme.title: Valentine: venganza oscura
programme.desc: Una joven se involucra con un hombre con la idea de que va a hacer una película cuando lo que él pretende es convertirla en vigilante enmascarada.

programme.title: El gran golpe
programme.desc: Una banda liderada por Macao Park planea un gran golpe en un casino. Pero sin honor entre ladrones, cada uno trama su propio plan para quedarse con el botín.

programme.title: Mentira de familias
programme.desc: Después de que sus padres murieran en lo que parece un accidente de coche, Emily y sus hermanos menores se mudan a un pequeño pueblo de Luisiana. Pronto comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas, dando a los hermanos la sensación de que están siendo observados.

programme.title: Las nuevas aventuras de Aladino
programme.desc: Dos empleados fracasados de unos grandes almacenes planean robar la tienda tras el cierre. Pero cuando un grupo de niños aparece pidiendo una historia, los hombres improvisan y empiezan a contar su propia versión del cuento de Aladino.

programme.title: Las nuevas aventuras de Aladino
programme.desc: Dos empleados fracasados de unos grandes almacenes planean robar la tienda tras el cierre. Pero cuando un grupo de niños aparece pidiendo una historia, los hombres improvisan y empiezan a contar su propia versión del cuento de Aladino.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: James Hunt y Niki Lauda, dos pilotos de Fórmula 1 extremadamente hábiles, mantienen entre sí una intensa rivalidad. Sin embargo, es su enemistad lo que les lleva al límite.

programme.title: Kickboxer
programme.desc: Kickboxing champ Eric Sloane is crippled in the ring by the evil Tong Po. Eric's younger brother, Kurt, seeks vengeance. Kurt learns Muay-Thai from fight guru Xian Chow. Thanks to Chow's unconventional training methods, Kurt becomes an expert kickboxer.

programme.title: Templario II: Batalla por la sangre
programme.desc: Reunidos por el joven Hubert, un reducido grupo de espadas a sueldo se reúne para buscar venganza por la muerte del hijo de uno de los mercenarios.

programme.title: El Regreso Del Samurai
programme.desc: Tras cumplir una condena de diez años de prisión, Lin regresa a casa para dejar atrás sus errores.

programme.title: Soldado Universal 3: Regeneración
programme.desc: Un equipo de radicales de la ex Unión Soviética irrumpe en Chernóbil y amenaza con desatar una nube radiactiva 100 veces más letal que Hiroshima y Nagasaki juntas.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres. Pronto se embarcarán en una misión suicida para volar un puente.

programme.title: Sí quiero, pero no quiero
programme.desc: Lauren, una joven divorciada que trabaja organizando bodas, se enamora del novio de una de sus clientas.

programme.title: El viaje del director de recursos humanos
programme.desc: El director de recursos humanos de la mayor panadería de Jerusalén tiene problemas. Se ha separado de su esposa; se ha distanciado de su hija, y está atrapado en un trabajo que le saca de quicio.

programme.title: La felicidad nunca viene sola
programme.desc: Un músico conoce a una mujer con una vida muy distinta y ambos se enamoran.

programme.title: Juerga de mamis
programme.desc: Cuatro madres salen a cenar juntas y terminan viviendo una noche inesperada llena de aventuras.

programme.title: Tipos Legales
programme.desc: Val (Al Pacino) sale de la cárcel tras cumplir 28 años de condena. Doc (Christopher Walken), su mejor amigo, le espera a la salida para ir a ver a Hirsch (Alan Arkin), otro viejo colega.

programme.title: El Ascenso
programme.desc: Dos subgerentes de una tienda de comestibles corporativa compiten por un codiciado ascenso.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Un militar conocido regresa al lugar de los mayores triunfos de su carrera. Ahí se reencuentra con un amor de años atrás, al mismo tiempo que va conociendo a la piloto de combate de la Fuerza Aérea que le asignan.

programme.title: Diario de un ejecutivo agresivo
programme.desc: Jack Giamoro, el mejor cazatalentos de Los Ángeles, parece tenerlo todo: una carrera de éxito, dinero y una hermosa mujer. Pero se siente vacío y decide asistir a las clases de creación literaria del pomposo y temperamental sr. Primkin.

programme.title: Detrás de la máscara: el encumbramiento de Leslie Vernon
programme.desc: Glen Echo es un tranquilo pueblo estadounidense donde, hace varios años, un niño fue arrojado de la cascada porque lo consideraban malvado. El niño sobrevivió y una vez que creció volvió a vivir cerca dispuesto a vengarse.

programme.title: La Columnista
programme.desc: El columnista y autor Femke está inundado de mensajes anónimos desagradables y amenazas de muerte en las redes sociales. Un día ella tiene suficiente y decide vengarse.

programme.title: Mentira de familias
programme.desc: Después de que sus padres murieran en lo que parece un accidente de coche, Emily y sus hermanos menores se mudan a un pequeño pueblo de Luisiana. Pronto comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas, dando a los hermanos la sensación de que están siendo observados.

programme.title: Acoso perfecto
programme.desc: Cuando una mujer (Danielle Savre) que sufre un trastorno histriónico de la personalidad se obsesiona con su nuevo vecino, se inventa un acosador imaginario.

programme.title: The Ledge
programme.desc: Tras haber tenido un tórrido romance con la mujer de un vecino (Liv Tyler), Gavin (Charlie Hunnam) está en la cornisa de un edificio de gran altura con la intención de saltar al vacío antes de mediodía.

programme.title: Cut Bank
programme.desc: Dwayne, un joven que fue atleta estrella y que ahora trabaja como mecánico, sueña con irse de la población de Cut Bank - la ciudad más fría de los EE.UU. - y mudarse a la gran ciudad, llevándose consigo a su novia Cassandra, que sueña con ser modelo.

programme.title: El asesinato de John Lennon
programme.desc: A finales de septiembre de 1980 Mark Chapman, cuyos transtornos mentales le convierten en una persona absolutamente inestable, llega a Nueva York con la idea de asesinar a John Lennon…

programme.title: Una historia real
programme.desc: James Franco y Jonah Hill protagonizan este tenso thriller sobre un hombre acusado de asesinar a toda su familia y el deshonrado reportero de periódico que dice ser, hasta que lo atrapan.

programme.title: Superstición
programme.desc: Lydia tiene que quedarse en la casa aislada de su tía. Por la noche oye ruidos y el descubrimiento la deja aterrorizada lo que unido a sueños reveladores la llevan a un camino de ambición, locura y venganza en el que ella es la protagonista.

programme.title: La mente de Menno
programme.desc: Menno es programador de computadoras en The Resort, una enorme casa de diversión donde las personas pueden vivir sus fantasías en realidad virtual.

programme.title: Sin rastro (Gone)
programme.desc: La policía no la cree, así que una mujer (Amanda Seyfried) emprende en solitario la búsqueda del asesino en serie del que escapó en el pasado y que ahora cree que ha secuestrado a su hermana.

programme.title: Escobar: Paraíso perdido
programme.desc: El joven surfista Nick (Josh Hutcherson) se enamora perdidamente de una hermosa chica. Todo parece perfecto hasta que conoce al tío de ella, el famoso capo de la droga Pablo Escobar (Benicio Del Toro).

programme.title: Amenazados
programme.desc: Thriller psicológico que gira en torno al interrogatorio, por parte de un agente del FBI, a un sospechoso de terrorismo para que confiese la ubicación de tres bombas nucleares preparadas para detonar en los Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 19
programme.desc: Lawson intenta salvar a Caleb de una vida de crimen, solo para descubrir que ya es demasiado tarde. Mientras tanto, la vida hogareña de Dom se acaba cuando la depresión de Sandrine amenaza con dañar a su bebé.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Una discusión sobre el cumpleaños de Kerry lleva a una apuesta sobre quién del el equipo tendrá relaciones sexuales con ella. Mientras tanto, Leon investiga una serie de robos de tiendas de videos, solo para encontrarse atrapado en un robo él mismo.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: El equipo ayuda a eliminar a las niñas menores de edad de una comunidad donde se han realizado informes de comportamiento inapropiado.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Stella choca con Lawson mientras el equipo espera el informe balístico sobre el tiroteo.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Después de rescatar a dos niños, la ira de Josh se derrama sobre su padre, quien puede haber intentado matarlos. El nuevo inspector desafía la posición de Josh en el equipo.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 2
programme.desc: Cuando dos adolescentes enamorados son perseguidos hasta un tejado y amenazan con suicidarse, Grace asume el cargo de negociadora principal, pero pronto se revela su inexperiencia.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 4
programme.desc: La Unidad de Respuesta Táctica persigue a un criminal que ataca a Grace mientras escapa. Josh permite que lo tomen como rehén. El criminal obliga a Josh a participar en un sádico juego de ruleta rusa.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 5
programme.desc: El equipo de Tactical Response se enfrenta a una situación peligrosa cuando un robo a mano armada se convierte en un asedio con rehenes en un pub suburbano. Lawson y Josh sorprenden a los ladrones y les disparan cuando llegan al pub.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 6
programme.desc: Grace, Josh y Dom están investigando un ataque de activistas en un laboratorio de investigación cuando estallan bombas incendiarias, poniendo en riesgo sus vidas. Stella descubre que su hermano, que también es policía, es corrupto.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 8
programme.desc: Después de que la hija de un político prominente y su amiga de la escuela son secuestradas, Kerry y el equipo de Respuesta Táctica deben realizar una operación encubierta para recuperar a las niñas de manera segura.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 9
programme.desc: Después de interrumpir un robo de autos en Lawson, Stella y Dom descubren un sindicato ilegal de renacimiento de vehículos, pero su sospechoso huye y Lawson lidera una persecución de autos cargada de adrenalina.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 10
programme.desc: Tactical Response es llamado a un edificio de medios donde un hombre descontento se ha encerrado en una habitación y está recitando artículos erróneos publicados por el periódico.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 11
programme.desc: Mientras Grace y Dom se recuperan en el hospital, Lawson y Stella deben lidiar con un exfutbolista suicida, mientras Josh y Michael descubren un misterioso intento de robo.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 12
programme.desc: Una pequeña disputa doméstica suburbana se vuelve desagradable y el esposo huye de la casa dejando a su esposa inconsciente y sangrando. Tactical Response persigue al hombre que está fuertemente armado y es peligroso.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 13
programme.desc: Cuando se llama a Tactical Response para proteger a una figura destacada del inframundo. Kerry sabe que la tarea es casi imposible. El hombre está siendo perseguido por sus socios de la mafia.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 1
programme.desc: Cuando se interrumpe un envío de armas ilegales en una terminal de contenedores, 'Tactical Response' encuentra a un guardia de seguridad herido pegado a un dispositivo explosivo.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 2
programme.desc: Cuando un sindicato de drogas atrae a un grupo de estudiantes para que actúen como mulas, 'Tactical Response' corre para evitar que se vayan antes que exploten los globos de heroína dentro de sus estómagos.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 3
programme.desc: Cuando llaman a 'Tactical Response' debido a una disputa doméstica, Lawson conecta bastante bien con un niño que lucha por cuidar a su padre borracho.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 4
programme.desc: Cuando un padre descontento toma como rehén a un juez de familia, 'Tactical Response' intenta encontrar una solución pacífica.

programme.title: Juana de Arco
programme.desc: Guiada por visiones divinas, Juana de Arco, adolescente del siglo XV, lidera a Francia en guerra. Parte 1.

programme.title: Juana de Arco
programme.desc: Guiada por visiones divinas, Juana de Arco, adolescente del siglo XV, lidera a Francia en guerra. Parte 2.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía
programme.desc: Un panadero observa cómo su vecina repite sin saberlo la historia de Madame Bovary.

programme.title: Recuerdo
programme.desc: Gordon inventa la máquina "Rememory" que le permite ver los recuerdos tal y como fueron en realidad.

programme.title: El sueño de una noche de verano
programme.desc: La obra más famosa de Shakespeare ha sido llevada a la luz dorada de las terrazas del norte de Italia a finales del s.XIX.

programme.title: La caza
programme.desc: Tras un divorcio difícil, Lucas, de cuarenta años, ha conocido a otra mujer, tiene un nuevo trabajo y se dispone a reconstruir la relación con Marcus, su hijo adolescente. Pero algo va mal. Un detalle. Un comentario inocente. Una mentira fortuita.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Un día, a Tom Avery (Martín Sheen), un reputado oftalmólogo viudo, le comunican que su hijo Daniel, con el que nunca ha tenido buenas relaciones, ha muerto en los Pirineos durante un temporal.

programme.title: Enamorarse

programme.title: Herbie Mann, Marc Cohen, Romero Lubambo & Paul Socolow
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1990, American flautist Herbert Jay Solomon, better known by his stage name Herbie Mann, was one of the artists appearing here. Together with Marc Cohen on piano, Romero Lubambo on guitar, Paul Socolow on bass, and both Ricky Sebastian and Cyro Baptista on percussion, Herbie Mann performs his infectious take on Brazilian-inspired music in this concert titled 'Jasil Brazz'.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sammy Price, Doc Cheatham, J.C. Higginbotham & Elmer Crumbley
programme.sub-title: Sammy Price and his All Star Orchestra
programme.desc: Texan pianist Sammy Price (1908-1992) played everything from blues and boogie-woogie to swing and jump-blues. Starting in Dallas as a singer and dancer in Alphonso Trent's orchestra, he went to Kansas to form the Texas Bluesicians. At the end of the 1930s, and as a house pianist for the Decca label, he backed many stars, including Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Trixie Smith. Price was equally at home playing the blues in a trio, or leading a bigger band playing the jump-blues people loved to dance to. In this 1958 recording, Sammy plays the Comblain-La-Tour Jazz Festival with his band.

programme.title: Quincy Jones, Porter Kilbert, Phil Woods & Budd Johnson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz Icons: Quincy Jones' spotlights a young ‘Q' conducting his ‘dream band'—an 18-piece orchestra of world-renowned players such as Clark Terry, Phil Woods, Sahib Shihab, Budd Johnson and Benny Bailey. This recording features 5 songs and is one of the finest examples of big band jazz ever to be captured on film. Shot in Belgium in 1961, this concert is one of the only known visual documents of this legendary tour.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Manu Katché, Alfio Origlio, Walter Ricci & Jérôme Regard
programme.sub-title: Katché & Origlio Quartet feat. Walter Ricci
programme.desc: Four exceptional musicians team up to perform classic pop and soul songs made famous by the likes of Gregory Porter, Stevie Wonder, U2, Seal, and many more. Pianist Alfio Origlio signed up to do the arrangements. Walter Ricci, an accomplished jazz vocalist from Naples, eases us into his musical universe with his stunning sensitivity. He is accompanied by an exceptional rhythm section composed of Manu Katché on drums, Jérôme Regard on bass, and Alfio Origlio on piano. This concert was recorded at Festival Jazz au Sommet 2020 in France.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Ron Carter
programme.desc: Ron Carter, Bobby Hutcherson and Joe Chambers are legends of Blue Note Records. They have established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons, Berliner Philharmoniker & Hilary Hahn
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world's finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo's magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák's Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber's Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich's Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979)

programme.title: David Radzynski, Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. Brahms completed his last symphony in 1885. He conducted the successful premiere of the piece in the German city of Meiningen in October of the same year. The symphony's finale movement is a chaconne, a variation form that reflects the composer's fascination with Baroque music. In this movement, Brahms borrowed an 8-measure theme from J. S. Bach's cantata ‘Nach dir, Herr, verlanget mich', BWV 150. The movement opens with the theme and then presents a set of variations all set over the same repeated theme in the bass. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko
programme.sub-title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A Ravel's La Valse (arr. for two pianos) Arensky's Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15 and Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance' from Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture' from Nikolai Kapustin's Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Schubert - Symphony No. 9 in C major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Franz Schubert's Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944. Also known as The Great, is the final symphony completed by Schubert. Unusually long for a symphony of its time, a typical performance of The Great lasts around one hour. The work was found to be very difficult for orchestras of the day because of its extremely lengthy woodwind and string parts. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's, London on January 7th, 2021.

programme.title: Bachman & Turner
programme.desc: Randy Bachman and C.F. “Fred” Turner were the core members of Bachman-Turner Overdrive throughout their commercial heyday in the seventies, sharing duties on the lead vocals with Bachman contributing lead guitar and Turner the bass. Between them they also composed the vast majority of the band's many hit singles. Reuniting at the end of 2009 they released an eponymous album in 2010 and in November of that year they performed at the famous Roseland Ballroom in New York City as part of their North American tour.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette
programme.desc: Alanis Morissette is one of the most successful female artists and songwriters of all time and has sold in excess of 60 million albums worldwide. Her voice is instantly recognisable and she is a consummate live performer. On 2 July 2012 Alanis Morissette returned to Montreux as part of her Guardian Angel Tour in support of her latest album "Havoc And Bright Lights". It was her third appearance at the festival. The set showcased a number of tracks from the new album alongside classic tracks from across her career. programme.desc: (2006) Thriller with Julie Benz. A woman returns to her home town for a funeral and reunites with her childhood friends, only to discover a shocking secret about the town that could tear them apart.)

programme.title: A Murderer Upstairs
programme.desc: (2017) Taut thriller starring Josie Davis. After her stepdaughter witnesses a murder, Cindy tries to protect her. But as the truth unravels, is the greatest danger living under her own roof?

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: After wrongly supporting a man who later turned out to be a serial killer, journalist Kate Fisher rebuilds her career but is stalked by someone from her past. Melissa George stars. (2010)

programme.title: Abducted
programme.desc: (2006) Captivating drama with Sarah Wynter. The lonely wife of a prison warden falls for an inmate she believes is innocent and helps him escape, only to make a shocking discovery about his motives.

programme.title: Out of Control
programme.desc: (2009) Thriller with Laura Vandervoort. A young forensic scientist gets the chance to play detective while secretly investigating a crime that could be tied to an ongoing murder.

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: David Ghantt is a simple man stuck in a monotonous life. Every day he drives an armored car, transporting millions with no escape in sight. The only bit of excitement is his crush Kelly Campbell, who lures him into the scheme of a lifetime.

programme.title: Gambit
programme.desc: Harry Deane is a man with a plan. Art curator for media tycoon Lord Lionel Shahbandar, Harry devises an elaborate plot to con Shahbandar into purchasing a fake Monet painting.

programme.title: Adrift
programme.desc: Adrift is based on the inspiring true story of two sailors who set out to journey across the ocean from Tahiti to San Diego...

programme.title: The Bookshop
programme.desc: 1959. Florence Green (Emily Mortimer), a free-spirited widow, puts grief behind her and risks everything to open up a bookshop - the first such shop in the sleepy seaside town of Hardborough, England...

programme.title: Be Cool
programme.desc: John Travolta is back as Mafia loan shark turned Hollywood Producer Chili Palmer in this sharp sequel to "Get Shorty." With an unbelievably hip all-star cast that also includes Uma Thurman, André 3000, Steve Tyler, Christina Milian and The Rock, and bursting with the hottest music in the biz.

programme.title: Blackbeard Part One
programme.desc: In 1717, Royal Navy Lieutenant Robert Maynard is sent to the West Indies on a secret mission to destroy notorious pirate ship The Queen Anne's Revenge and its crew.

programme.title: Blackbeard Part Two
programme.desc: In 1717, Royal Navy Lieutenant Robert Maynard is sent to the West Indies on a secret mission to destroy notorious pirate ship The Queen Anne's Revenge and its crew.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: The Wrong Patient
programme.desc: Dr. Jen Richards, a successful plastic surgeon, becomes entangled in the web of a narcissist patient whose path to perfection threatens to destroy Jen and her family.

programme.title: Trinity Is Still My Name
programme.desc: Bambino tries to teach his brother Trinity how to become an outlaw, but the two wind up saving a pioneer family and breaking up an arms ring instead.

programme.title: Hurricane Season
programme.desc: In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, high school basketball coach Al Collins assembles students from five different Louisiana schools and leads them all the way to the state championships.

programme.title: High Crimes
programme.desc: A woman's life becomes embroiled in a huge military cover-up when it's revealed her husband is not who he says he is.

programme.title: What Happens In Vegas
programme.desc: Two strangers who drunkenly get married in Vegas fight over a huge jackpot.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: Justin Timberlake and Amanda Seyfried co-star in this sci-fi thriller set in a future world where aging stops at 25, and the only way for one man to stay alive is to steal more time.

programme.title: The Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: In The Butterfly Effect Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) has lost crucial moments of his life, his childhood scarred by a series of terrifying events he can't remember. When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: I Know Who Killed Me
programme.desc: An idyllic small town is rocked when Aubrey Fleming (Lindsay Lohan), a bright and promising young college student is abducted and tortured by a sadistic serial killer. When she manages to escape, the traumatised girl who regains consciousness in the hospital insists that her identity is that of Dakota Moss a stripper in a seedy club and that the real Aubrey Fleming is still in mortal danger. A taut and gripping erotic thriller with a captivating riddle at its centre, I Know Who Killed Me explores the dark side of identity, sexuality and obsession.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Lez Bomb
programme.desc: Lez Bomb is a hilarious and sweet “coming out” comedy in the vein of Meet the Parents from Bobby Farrelly, producer of There's Something about Mary. Lauren, (Writer-Director Jenna Laurenzo) comes home with life changing news. As it turns out, there is no good time to drop the Lez Bomb.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: For one family protecting their land on the Texas-Mexico border is everything but an encounter with an immigrant family leads to Jackson accidentally killing a boy. With his father Bill (Frank Grillo - Captain America: The Winter Soldier) attempting to take the blame, Jackson flees and crosses the border into Mexico. Now an illegal alien himself, he faces the very fears he imposed on others.

programme.title: Arthur and Merlin
programme.desc: A spectacular fantasy-epic, recounting the legendary adventures of two iconic characters. In Dark Ages Britain, a time of myth and magic, a Saxon force from the East attacks the Celtic people. However, hope is not lost when Arthur, a banished warrior, and Merlin, a hermit wizard, embark on a heroic quest to save their people. A mystic and mythical tale of courage and valour.

programme.title: Willy's Wonderland
programme.desc: Stranded in a remote town with a car that wont work and no way to pay the local repair shop, THE JANITOR agrees to spend the night in an abandoned theme park full of animatronic characters that were once a joy to the kids of the town, but now hold a dark secret. As night falls, these once happy mascots come to life and theyre out for blood. Survive at any cost, its only one night!

programme.title: The Body
programme.desc: A crucified body dated back to the first century A.D is uncovered at an ancient cave in Jerusalem. Trouble ensues as word spreads.

programme.title: The Man Without a Face
programme.desc: A drama film about a young boy who befriends a disfigured recluse in a small coastal town and helps him overcome his fear of society and confront his past.

programme.title: Curtain Call
programme.desc: With opening night fast approaching, a beloved Broadway star must overcome insurmountable odds to deliver the performance of a lifetime.

programme.title: Baked With A Kiss
programme.desc: (2022) Culinary romance starring Jonathan Stoddard and Ansley Gordon. Renowned for her magical True Love pie, a baker accidentally serves one to a rude customer, who ends up falling in love with her.

programme.title: Brimming With Love
programme.desc: Stuck in a newspaper sales department, Allie (Kelsey Asbille) is thrilled when her boss, Mr. Rickford (George Newbern) gives her a chance at writing her own summer series of articles.

programme.title: Love, Romance and Chocolate
programme.desc: Emma and chocolatier Luc compete for Belgium's Royal Chocolatier. The beauty and romance of Bruges inspire unique chocolate combinations, but will their entry win without them losing their hearts?

programme.title: The Baker's Son
programme.desc: The locals of Windwards Island always knows when talented baker Matt has fallen in love, his loaves taste delicious. So, when his bread stops tasting bland, is it due to the newcomer or friend Annie?

programme.title: Between us
programme.desc: Henry and Dianne fear that settling down means giving up on their dreams. It will take the universe conspiring to keep them apart for them to realize just how much they need each other.

programme.title: 23 Walks
programme.desc: Dave and Fern, two older strangers, have been bruised by their individual circumstance. They meet walking their dogs in a North London park, and over the course of twenty-three walks together romance begins to blossom.

programme.title: Love Type D
programme.desc: How can someone love you yesterday and not today? Shortly after her boyfriend sends his 12-year-old brother (Wilbur) to break the news that she's dumped, Frankie Browne (27) discovers that she has a loser in love gene. Every man she goes out with will inevitably break up with her.

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars Lindstrom is an akwardly shy young man in a small town who finally brings home the girl of his dreams to his brother and sister-in-law's home. The only problem is that she's not real - she's a sex doll.

programme.title: Then Came You
programme.desc: A lonely widow plans a trip around the world with her husband's ashes, to visit the places they loved in the movies. The first stop on the journey changes her life forever.

programme.title: Manhattan
programme.desc: Woody Allen, Diane Keaton, Meryl Streep and Mariel Hemingway star in Woody Allen's extraordinary and funny film that explores the embattled life and loves of a successful New York comedy writer.

programme.title: Return To Me
programme.desc: A man who falls in love with the woman who received his wife's heart must decide which woman it is who holds his heart.

programme.title: Cream of the Crop
programme.desc: High-school Ag Science teacher Jodi Stafford meets commercial real-estate marketing specialist Mike Jared during her struggle to save her family's ailing dairy farm.

programme.desc: An independent country girl, Paisley, takes on the task of upholding her adored grandfather's ranch. After being denied the funding needed to refurbish the ranch, she is reintroduced to her ex-boyfriend Josh, a big-time marketing executive stationed in Denver who has been suspended from his current position at his company. Admitting to herself that she needs the help, Paisley agrees to work with Josh while he is town to come up with ideas on how to raise money for the farm.

programme.title: Love in Focus
programme.desc: When the hit show actress Jenna Wilde stars in suddenly gets cancelled, the press start circling. To escape the chaos Jenna retreats to a snowy cabin in the mountains. Unexpectedly, she must share this peaceful place with a rude and rugged nature photographer Chris Dixon. Their coolness towards each other starts to thaw when Chris helps Jenna audition for other shows.

programme.title: Newlywed and Dead
programme.desc: Kristin begins to doubt her husband's love when his aunt and rival is found dead.

programme.title: The Wife He Met Online
programme.desc: Bryant tends his daughter, works, but is intrigued by an LA woman's profile.

programme.title: Kelly / Rose / Lt. Prescott and Gwen
programme.desc: A mother of three survives a prolonged attack from her estranged husband.

programme.desc: Kristin begins to doubt her husband's love when his aunt and rival is found dead.

programme.title: Major League II
programme.desc: The Indians are now a World Series contender. But last year's hunger is now replaced with complacency, and bad decisions by the new owner threaten to tear the team apart.

programme.title: Little Man
programme.desc: A short, baby-faced jewel thief masquerades as a baby to try to recover a stolen diamond.

programme.title: Herbie Mann, Marc Cohen, Romero Lubambo & Paul Socolow
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1990, American flautist Herbert Jay Solomon, better known by his stage name Herbie Mann, was one of the artists appearing here. Together with Marc Cohen on piano, Romero Lubambo on guitar, Paul Socolow on bass, and both Ricky Sebastian and Cyro Baptista on percussion, Herbie Mann performs his infectious take on Brazilian-inspired music in this concert titled 'Jasil Brazz'.

programme.title: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sammy Price, Doc Cheatham, J.C. Higginbotham & Elmer Crumbley
programme.sub-title: Sammy Price and his All Star Orchestra
programme.desc: Texan pianist Sammy Price (1908-1992) played everything from blues and boogie-woogie to swing and jump-blues. Starting in Dallas as a singer and dancer in Alphonso Trent's orchestra, he went to Kansas to form the Texas Bluesicians. At the end of the 1930s, and as a house pianist for the Decca label, he backed many stars, including Sister Rosetta Tharpe and Trixie Smith. Price was equally at home playing the blues in a trio, or leading a bigger band playing the jump-blues people loved to dance to. In this 1958 recording, Sammy plays the Comblain-La-Tour Jazz Festival with his band.

programme.title: Quincy Jones, Porter Kilbert, Phil Woods & Budd Johnson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz Icons: Quincy Jones' spotlights a young ‘Q' conducting his ‘dream band'—an 18-piece orchestra of world-renowned players such as Clark Terry, Phil Woods, Sahib Shihab, Budd Johnson and Benny Bailey. This recording features 5 songs and is one of the finest examples of big band jazz ever to be captured on film. Shot in Belgium in 1961, this concert is one of the only known visual documents of this legendary tour.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Manu Katché, Alfio Origlio, Walter Ricci & Jérôme Regard
programme.sub-title: Katché & Origlio Quartet feat. Walter Ricci
programme.desc: Four exceptional musicians team up to perform classic pop and soul songs made famous by the likes of Gregory Porter, Stevie Wonder, U2, Seal, and many more. Pianist Alfio Origlio signed up to do the arrangements. Walter Ricci, an accomplished jazz vocalist from Naples, eases us into his musical universe with his stunning sensitivity. He is accompanied by an exceptional rhythm section composed of Manu Katché on drums, Jérôme Regard on bass, and Alfio Origlio on piano. This concert was recorded at Festival Jazz au Sommet 2020 in France.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Ron Carter
programme.desc: Ron Carter, Bobby Hutcherson and Joe Chambers are legends of Blue Note Records. They have established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Philip Catherine, Jean-Louis Rassinfosse & Chet Baker
programme.sub-title: Jazz a la Grand Place Chet Baker Trio
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital's central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano's “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include “Down” and “How Deep is the Ocean”.

programme.title: Mariss Jansons, Berliner Philharmoniker & Hilary Hahn
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world's finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo's magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák's Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber's Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich's Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979)

programme.title: David Radzynski, Franz Welser-Möst & Cleveland Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Les Dissonances & David Grimal
programme.sub-title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances perform Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. Brahms completed his last symphony in 1885. He conducted the successful premiere of the piece in the German city of Meiningen in October of the same year. The symphony's finale movement is a chaconne, a variation form that reflects the composer's fascination with Baroque music. In this movement, Brahms borrowed an 8-measure theme from J. S. Bach's cantata ‘Nach dir, Herr, verlanget mich', BWV 150. The movement opens with the theme and then presents a set of variations all set over the same repeated theme in the bass. This performance was recorded at Opéra de Dijon, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko
programme.sub-title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A Ravel's La Valse (arr. for two pianos) Arensky's Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15 and Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance' from Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture' from Nikolai Kapustin's Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Jos van Immerseel, Anima Eterna Brugge, Claron McFadden & Bart Van Caenegem
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin's symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928). After, soprano Claron McFadden joins the orchestra, presenting a selection of Gershwin's classic jazz songs, including ‘The man I love' (1924-27), ‘I got rhythm' (1930), and ‘By Strauss' (1936). She also performs ‘My man's gone now' and ‘Summertime' from Porgy and Bess. The concert ends with Gershwin's celebrated Rhapsody in Blue, with Bart Van Caenegem as featured pianist. This performance was recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on March 3, 2017.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Schubert - Symphony No. 9 in C major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Franz Schubert's Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944. Also known as The Great, is the final symphony completed by Schubert. Unusually long for a symphony of its time, a typical performance of The Great lasts around one hour. The work was found to be very difficult for orchestras of the day because of its extremely lengthy woodwind and string parts. This performance is recorded at St. Luke's, London on January 7th, 2021.

programme.title: Yes
programme.desc: "Songs From Tsongas" is a live performance from Yes' 35th Anniversary Tour in 2004, the last tour by the band to feature the classic line-up of Jon Anderson, Steve Howe, Chris Squire, Rick Wakeman and Alan White.

programme.title: Bachman & Turner
programme.desc: Randy Bachman and C.F. “Fred” Turner were the core members of Bachman-Turner Overdrive throughout their commercial heyday in the seventies, sharing duties on the lead vocals with Bachman contributing lead guitar and Turner the bass. Between them they also composed the vast majority of the band's many hit singles. Reuniting at the end of 2009 they released an eponymous album in 2010 and in November of that year they performed at the famous Roseland Ballroom in New York City as part of their North American tour.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette
programme.desc: Alanis Morissette is one of the most successful female artists and songwriters of all time and has sold in excess of 60 million albums worldwide. Her voice is instantly recognisable and she is a consummate live performer. On 2 July 2012 Alanis Morissette returned to Montreux as part of her Guardian Angel Tour in support of her latest album "Havoc And Bright Lights". It was her third appearance at the festival. The set showcased a number of tracks from the new album alongside classic tracks from across her career. programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: Eran 12 saboteadores. Los Nazis mataron a 11. Esta es la verdadera historia del que se escapó.

programme.desc: Sobria película de espías a la vieja escuela llena de tensión y suspense. Un joven ruso sin papeles consigue llegar a la ciudad de Hamburgo. Lleva encima una sorprendente cantidad de dinero. Annabel, una abogada defensora de derechos civiles, intenta que no lo deporten.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
